title: C: Inline Assembly (Simulated)
description: Simulate inline assembly by writing C functions that model assembly operations: add, sub, mov, cmp, and jmp using function pointers and labels.

steps.title: Simulated Assembly Operations
steps.description: Simulate a simple CPU with registers (int array of 4). Implement `mov(regs, dst, src)`, `add(regs, dst, src)`, `sub(regs, dst, src)` that manipulate the registers. Print register state after each operation.
hints: Registers: r0, r1, r2, r3 stored in an int array.

verification.failureMessage: Run the assembly simulation and print final register state
